title: Top 20 New Business Ideas in India 2026
summary: 20 new business ideas in India 2026: AI services, loan agency, EV and drone work, and low investment startups, with costs and time to first profit.
body_markdown:
The best new business ideas of 2026 look nothing like the shop-and-stock businesses of ten years ago: they run on phones, sell through WhatsApp and Instagram, and many start with almost no money. This guide covers 20 new business ideas in India, from AI services and loan agencies to offbeat[unique business ideas](https://gromo.in/blog/unique-business-ideas/) like drone services, each with the investment needed, time to first income, and exactly how to start, so you can pick your idea from this one page; for traditional options, the classic[small business ideas](https://gromo.in/blog/small-business-ideas/) list pairs well with this one.


## New Business Ideas: Quick Facts


Question Answer


Cheapest new business ideas Loan agency, UGC creation, WhatsApp store, print on demand: near Rs 0 to start


Fastest to first income Loan agency and reselling: first payout in 1 to 4 weeks


Newest high-growth spaces AI services, EV-related services, drone work, pet care, eco products


Best for ladies starting from home Instagram boutique, beauty studio, handmade brand, cloud kitchen, loan agency


Typical registration Start informally; add GST, FSSAI, or licences as revenue grows


## Newest Startup Ideas: Digital and AI


### 1. AI Services Agency for Local Businesses


**Investment** Zero to Rs 10,000 (tool subscriptions)


**Time to first income** 2 to 6 weeks


**Best for** Anyone comfortable learning AI tools


Small businesses want what AI promises, faster replies, better content, automated bookings, but have nobody to set it up. You bridge that gap: build WhatsApp auto-replies, write AI-assisted content, create product photos, and manage chatbots for shops, clinics, and coaching centres at monthly retainers of Rs 5,000 to Rs 20,000 per client.


**How to start:** master 3 or 4 tools, do one free setup for a local business, and turn the result into your pitch for the next ten.


### 2. Loan Agency: Start With GroMo


**Investment** Zero; registration and training are free


**Time to first income** 1 to 3 weeks, on your first disbursed loan


**Best for** Anyone with a network; no finance degree needed


People around you constantly need personal loans, business loans, and credit cards but do not know which lender will approve them. A loan agency solves exactly that, and it is one of the few businesses you can start today with zero money: on the GroMo app you distribute loans from 30+ RBI-regulated banks and NBFC lending partners, and earn a[DSA loan agent commission](https://gromo.in/blog/dsa-loan-agent-commission/) , typically 0.5% to 4% of the disbursed amount, on every loan that gets approved.


A single Rs 4,00,000 personal loan at a 2 percent payout earns Rs 8,000 from one customer. Free GroMo Academy lessons cover the products and the selling method, eligibility checks happen in the app, and every application is tracked transparently.


As your customers repay and return for their next loan, the agency compounds into a serious business.


**How to start:** complete the free[DSA loan agent registration](https://gromo.in/blog/dsa-loan-agent-registration/) on GroMo, finish the Academy lessons, and begin with the loan needs already sitting in your own contact list.


### 3. UGC Content Creation for Brands


**Investment** Zero; phone camera is enough


**Time to first income** 3 to 6 weeks


**Best for** People comfortable on camera, no followers needed


Brands now pay creators for content they run as ads, without caring how many followers the creator has. UGC (user-generated content) creators shoot product demo reels and testimonials from home at Rs 1,500 to Rs 10,000 per video.


It is one of the newest ways to earn from content without waiting years to build an audience.


**How to start:** shoot 5 sample videos for products you own, build a one-page portfolio, and pitch D2C brands on Instagram and LinkedIn.


### 4. WhatsApp and Social Commerce Store


**Investment** Zero (reselling) to Rs 20,000 (own stock)


**Time to first income** First week possible


**Best for** Anyone with active WhatsApp and Instagram circles


A store without a website: catalogue on WhatsApp Business, orders in chat, payments by UPI. Start with reselling apps so you hold no stock, then add your own products once you know what your audience buys. Social commerce is how a large share of tier 2 and tier 3 India shops now.


**How to start:** set up WhatsApp Business with a catalogue, share a curated selection daily, and deliver reliably.


### 5. Digital Marketing for Local Businesses


**Investment** Zero to Rs 5,000


**Time to first income** 2 to 4 weeks


**Best for** Anyone who understands Instagram and Google better than a shop owner


Restaurants, salons, clinics, and coaching centres need Google Business profiles, Instagram reels, and review management, and will pay Rs 3,000 to Rs 15,000 monthly for someone dependable. Three to five retainer clients make a real income, and results compound into referrals across the market.


**How to start:** manage one local business free for 15 days, show the improvement in reach, and convert it to a retainer.


### 6. Regional-Language Online Course Studio


**Investment** Zero to Rs 10,000


**Time to first income** 1 to 3 months


**Best for** Teachers and specialists in any skill


Courses in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Bengali, and other Indian languages are massively underserved compared to English. Record once, sell repeatedly: exam prep, spoken English, Excel, tailoring, cooking, coding. Course platforms and simple UPI payment links remove all technical barriers.


**How to start:** outline one course that solves one problem, record with your phone, and sell to your first students directly.


## Latest Service Business Ideas


### 7. EV Charging and Support Services


**Investment** Rs 50,000 to Rs 3 lakh depending on setup


**Time to first income** 1 to 3 months


**Best for** Owners of roadside space or existing shops


Electric two-wheelers and cars are multiplying faster than charging points. A charging station at a shop, parking lot, or highway dhaba earns per unit of electricity sold, and adding EV washing, basic servicing, and battery care builds a full service point around the same customers.


**How to start:** check your electricity connection capacity, start with 2-wheeler charging points, and register on charging-discovery apps.


### 8. Drone Services


**Investment** Rs 60,000 to Rs 3 lakh (drone plus certification)


**Time to first income** 1 to 2 months after certification


**Best for** Tech-comfortable operators, agriculture areas especially


Drones now earn across agriculture spraying, land surveys, wedding shoots, and real estate walkthroughs. Agricultural spraying alone books solid seasonal income per acre, and certified pilots are still scarce, which keeps day rates high.


**How to start:** complete a DGCA-recognised drone pilot course, start with photography or agri-spraying in your district, and let word of mouth spread.


### 9. Home Automation Installation


**Investment** Rs 10,000 to Rs 40,000 (demo kit and tools)


**Time to first income** 2 to 6 weeks


**Best for** Electrically-handy people in cities


Smart lights, video doorbells, security cameras, and voice-controlled switches are cheap now, but most families want someone to choose, install, and configure them. Per-home projects run Rs 5,000 to Rs 50,000, and builders and interior designers become repeat referral sources.


**How to start:** automate your own home as the demo, then partner with one electrician and one interior designer.


### 10. Refurbished Electronics Business


**Investment** Rs 25,000 to Rs 1 lakh


**Time to first income** 2 to 4 weeks


**Best for** People who know phones and laptops well


India's appetite for good second-hand phones and laptops keeps growing. Buy used devices, refurbish honestly, and sell with a short warranty; margins run Rs 1,500 to Rs 8,000 per device. Trust and transparent grading are the whole brand.


**How to start:** learn testing and grading, start with 3 to 5 devices, and sell through WhatsApp and local marketplaces.


### 11. Pet Care Services


**Investment** Rs 10,000 to Rs 50,000


**Time to first income** 2 to 4 weeks


**Best for** Animal lovers in cities


Pet ownership is booming and services have not kept up. Grooming, walking, boarding during travel, and pet taxi services all charge premium urban rates: grooming alone runs Rs 500 to Rs 2,000 per session, and boarding earns per night with almost no marketing once trust builds.


**How to start:** begin with walking and boarding in your society, add grooming after a short course.


## Best Business Ideas in Low Investment


### 12. Single-Dish Cloud Kitchen


**Investment** Rs 15,000 to Rs 60,000


**Time to first income** 2 to 4 weeks


**Best for** Good cooks with a delivery-friendly location


Instead of a full menu, new-age kitchens win with one perfected item: biryani, momos, thepla, or a signature dessert. One dish means simple sourcing, consistent quality, and a memorable brand on delivery apps.


**How to start:** perfect one recipe, list on delivery platforms with strong photos, and expand the menu only after reviews stabilise.


### 13. Healthy Meal Prep and Diet Kitchen


**Investment** Rs 10,000 to Rs 40,000


**Time to first income** 2 to 4 weeks; subscriptions pay upfront


**Best for** Cooks who understand nutrition basics


Gym-goers and health-conscious professionals pay Rs 4,000 to Rs 10,000 monthly for calorie-counted meal subscriptions, well above regular tiffin rates. Partner with local gyms and dieticians for a steady customer pipeline.


**How to start:** design 2 weekly menus with macros listed, sign your first 5 customers through a nearby gym.


### 14. Print on Demand Brand


**Investment** Zero to Rs 5,000


**Time to first income** 1 to 3 months


**Best for** Design-minded creators


T-shirts, mugs, and posters print only when a customer orders, so there is no stock risk at all. Niche designs, college humour, regional pride, pet parents, sell steadily once discovered, and each design keeps earning after its first sale.


**How to start:** create 15 to 20 designs in one niche, list on print-on-demand marketplaces, and promote through reels.


### 15. Thrift and Fashion Resale Store


**Investment** Rs 5,000 to Rs 30,000


**Time to first income** 1 to 3 weeks


**Best for** Fashion-savvy young founders


Curated second-hand and surplus fashion sells fast on Instagram to Gen Z buyers who love sustainable, affordable style. Drops of 20 to 40 curated pieces sell out through stories and DMs, with margins of 2 to 4 times sourcing cost.


**How to start:** source a small curated lot, photograph well, and run weekly drop-style sales on Instagram.


## Best Business Ideas for Ladies


Every idea in this article is open to everyone; this section highlights the ones women in India are building most successfully from home, with full control over hours.


### 16. Instagram Boutique


**Investment** Rs 10,000 to Rs 50,000 for the first collection


**Time to first income** 2 to 4 weeks


**Best for** Women with an eye for fashion


Sarees, suits, and jewellery curated from wholesale markets and sold through Instagram and WhatsApp make one of the most proven home businesses for women. Live video sales and festive collections drive peaks, and loyal customers reorder for every occasion.


**How to start:** begin with one small curated collection, deliver locally yourself, and reinvest margins into the next collection.


### 17. Home Beauty Studio


**Investment** Rs 15,000 to Rs 50,000


**Time to first income** 1 to 3 weeks


**Best for** Trained or willing-to-train beauticians


A dedicated room at home beats salon economics: no rent, personal service, and appointment-based hours you control. Bridal packages become the profit engine, paying several thousand per booking each wedding season.


**How to start:** complete a certification course, serve your colony first, and post every look on Instagram.


### 18. Handmade and Craft Brand


**Investment** Rs 5,000 to Rs 25,000


**Time to first income** 3 to 6 weeks


**Best for** Makers: candles, resin art, crochet, jewellery, gifting


Handmade candles, resin work, crochet, and personalised gifting sell at 3 to 5 times material cost, especially in wedding and festival seasons. Marketplaces and Instagram bring buyers far beyond your city, and corporate gifting orders scale a hobby into a brand.


**How to start:** perfect 3 to 5 products, price for profit honestly, and target one festival season as your launch.


### 19. Financial Products Distribution From Home


**Investment** Zero


**Time to first income** 1 to 2 weeks


**Best for** Women with strong family and community networks


The same[GroMo Partner](https://gromo.in/blog/gromo-partner/) model from idea 2 fits home life perfectly: recommend credit cards, savings accounts, loans, and demat accounts to your circle, at whatever hours suit you, and earn a payout per approved product. Many women build it around household schedules, and the trust networks women maintain convert better than any advertising.


**How to start:** free registration, free training, and your first recommendations to family and neighbours.


### 20. Daycare and Kids' Activity Classes


**Investment** Rs 10,000 to Rs 50,000


**Time to first income** First month; fees are monthly


**Best for** Patient, organised caregivers and teachers


Daycare earns steady monthly fees from working parents, and adding evening activity classes, drawing, dance, abacus, phonics, doubles revenue from the same space. Safety standards and open communication with parents are the entire reputation.


**How to start:** child-proof one room, start with 3 to 5 children from your building, and add one activity class.


## How to Choose Your New Business Idea


1. **Match the idea to your assets:** network (loan agency, boutique), skill (AI services, courses), space (EV charging, daycare), or capital (refurbished electronics, drones).
2. **Prefer repeat-revenue models:** retainers, subscriptions, renewals, and referral chains grow while one-time sales restart from zero monthly; that is the engine inside every[low cost business idea with high profit](https://gromo.in/blog/low-cost-business-ideas-with-high-profit/) .
3. **Test before you invest:** one free client, one small collection, one perfected dish. Proof first, money later.
4. **Start where competition is thin:** regional languages, tier 2 and 3 towns, and underserved niches beat crowded metro markets.
5. **Keep the day job until the business pays twice your needs** for three straight months.


## FAQ: New Business Ideas


**Which is the best new business idea in India in 2026?**


For zero capital, a loan agency through GroMo is the strongest new business: free registration, commissions of 0.5% to 4% per disbursed loan, and first income within weeks. If you can invest, AI services for local businesses, pet care, and EV-related services are the newest spaces with growing demand and thin competition.


**What are the best business ideas in low investment?**


Under Rs 10,000 you can start a loan agency on GroMo, UGC content creation, a WhatsApp store through reselling, an AI services agency, and print on demand. Between Rs 10,000 and Rs 60,000, a single-dish cloud kitchen, meal-prep kitchen, thrift store, or handmade brand become possible.


All reach first income within weeks of starting.


**What are the best business ideas for ladies at home?**


The most proven home businesses for women in India are an Instagram boutique, a home beauty studio, a handmade and craft brand, daycare with activity classes, and financial product distribution on GroMo. All five run on flexible hours, need little or no starting capital, and grow on the trust networks women already maintain.


**Which new startup ideas have the most growth ahead?**


AI services, EV charging and support, drone operations, pet care, regional-language online courses, and refurbished electronics all ride growth curves that are still early in India. Each one has demand growing faster than supply, which keeps pricing strong for early movers.


**How do I start a loan agency in India?**


Register free as a loan agent on a distribution platform like GroMo, complete the free training, and start sharing loan options from its 30+ RBI-regulated lending partners with people who need them. You earn a commission on every disbursed loan, need no office or finance degree, and eligibility checks happen inside the app.


**Can I start a new business while keeping my job?**


Yes, and you should. Most ideas in this list, loan agency, UGC creation, print on demand, WhatsApp store, AI services, run comfortably in 2 to 3 hours a day. Keep the job until the business pays about twice your monthly needs for three straight months, then decide with real numbers instead of hope.
